en.advisory_explanation: SYLTRA has not confirmed this and will not act on it alone.

en.approval_needs_permission: This is waiting for approval from someone who holds the approval permission.

en.audit_readonly_detail: The audit trail is append-only. Nothing here can be edited or deleted, including by an owner.
en.automation_turned_off: Switched off. It stays here and can be switched back on.
en.confirmed_explanation: Confirmed by a certified detector, not by a model.

en.current_power_summary: Summed from {n} of {total} metered devices reporting now.

en.denied_title: You do not have permission to see this
en.detail_degraded_detail: Some capabilities are current and some are not. Each one is marked below.
en.detail_degraded_title: This device is reporting only part of its state

en.failure_detail: Local control and safety monitoring run on the hub and are unaffected. Only this view failed.

en.feedback_recorded_NEVER_REPEAT: Noted — SYLTRA will stop proposing this.
en.feedback_recorded_NOT_NOW: Noted — SYLTRA will not raise this again for now.
en.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.
en.from_learned_pattern: From a pattern SYLTRA learned in this home.
en.health_ok_detail: Every component reported ok at the last check.
en.history_complete: Every hour in this period has readings.

en.identifier_note: This property has no display name yet; its identifier is shown.
en.invite_detail: Guest and installer access ends by itself. Owner access does not.
en.language_help: Changes the language and text direction
en.learning_controls_detail: What SYLTRA learns, and what it keeps, is under your control in settings.
en.mode_ACT_WITH_APPROVAL_detail: Approved kinds of action run automatically. Manual control always overrides them.
en.mode_APPROVAL_REQUIRED_permits: Actions are prepared but never dispatched without a person's approval.
en.mode_AUTHORIZED_AUTOMATION_permits: Approved kinds of action run automatically. Manual control always overrides them, and safety actions never run this way.
en.mode_DISABLED_permits: SYLTRA is not learning and proposes nothing.
en.mode_OBSERVE_detail: SYLTRA is learning this home and proposes nothing yet.
en.mode_OBSERVE_permits: SYLTRA is learning this home. It proposes nothing and changes nothing.
en.mode_RECOMMEND_detail: SYLTRA proposes actions. Each one waits for a person.
en.mode_RECOMMEND_permits: SYLTRA proposes actions. Every one waits for a person; nothing runs on its own.
en.mode_SHADOW_detail: Predictions are recorded and compared, but nothing acts on them.
en.mode_SHADOW_permits: Predictions are recorded and compared against what happens. Nothing is proposed and nothing runs.
en.mode_SUSPENDED_permits: Learning is stopped. SYLTRA proposes nothing until a new model version is promoted.
en.models_technical_label: Model detail — shown because your role can act on it.
en.name: Name
en.no_anomalies: Nothing unusual in the metered devices.
en.no_anomaly_model: No anomaly model has been trained

en.no_audit_matches_detail: There are entries, but none matches these filters.

en.no_evidence: No evidence is recorded for this case.
en.no_history_at_all_detail: Nothing has reported power for this property yet.
en.no_history_yet: Not enough history to draw yet
en.no_history_yet_detail: Readings are being recorded. A chart appears once there is an hour of them.
en.no_matches_detail: The home has devices; none of them match the filters above.
en.no_members: Nobody has been given access to this property yet
en.no_metering: No device in this property meters power

en.no_plan_detail: A confirmed hazard should authorise a response. That none is recorded is itself worth reporting.
en.no_problems: Nothing needs attention in this room.
en.no_properties_detail: Nobody has given you access to a property yet. Ask an owner to add you.
en.no_timeline: Nothing has been decided or dispatched yet.
en.not_yet_available: This part of SYLTRA is not available yet. It arrives in a later phase.
en.observe_only_detail: SYLTRA is learning your home and will not send anything to a device. Recommendations and automations are still worked out, and every one is recorded so you can see what it would have done.
en.observe_only_title: This hub is watching, not acting
en.partial_detail: Everything else on this page is current. Missing: {what}.
en.partial_title: Some data could not be loaded
en.platform_settings_missing: User and installation settings are not here yet
en.platform_settings_missing_detail: Managing who has access, and tracking installation projects, need platform features that do not exist yet. A permissions editor that cannot save would be worse than none — it would imply the change took effect.
en.policy_ESCALATE_TO_FIXED_SAFETY_RULE: Handed to a fixed safety rule
en.policy_missing_detail: SYLTRA will not act on a proposal that policy has not judged. Nothing can be approved here.
en.policy_shadow_detail: This is a shadow prediction. It is recorded and compared, and there is nothing to approve.
en.power_over_time_summary: {buckets} hours measured, {missing} with no readings. Highest reading {peak} watts.
en.privacy_note: Your household data stays on this hub. Cloud sync is off.
en.privacy_requires_permission: Export and deletion need the privacy permission.
en.privacy_via_operator: Export and deletion run through the operator tools, where they are confirmed and recorded. A household's whole record is not something to remove with one click.
en.properties_note: City, energy and ownership are not held by the platform yet, so those columns are absent rather than empty.
en.properties_partial: Some properties could not be read
en.properties_partial_detail: Rows for {what} are incomplete. A blank is shown where a number could not be read, rather than a zero.
en.reason_required_detail: Whoever reads the audit trail later needs to know why access changed.
en.response_blocked_detail: It operates a device, and needs approval this system has not been given.
en.response_dispatched: A command was sent to a device.
en.response_none: No notification step is defined for this response.
en.response_not_dispatched: Nothing has been sent to any device.
en.response_prepared_detail: SYLTRA has identified {device} and verified it can be reached. It would be set to {value}. The command has not been sent and will not be sent by this console.
en.response_unreachable: Prepared, but no device can be reached
en.risk_not_found_detail: It may have closed, or it belongs to another property.
en.room_not_found_detail: No device in this property reports that room.
en.sections_not_yet: Some sections are not available yet
en.sections_not_yet_detail: Automations and energy arrive in a later phase. Nothing is hidden — the platform does not produce them yet.
en.shadow: Learning only — not shown to the home
en.signed_out: You are signed out. Reload with a valid token to continue.
en.state_unknown_detail: SYLTRA has not received a reading from this device.
en.suspended_detail: It stopped matching this home, so SYLTRA suspended it rather than keep proposing from it. A new version has to be promoted before it returns.
en.suspended_title: A model has been stood down
en.test_run_detail: Every automation was checked against the home as it is right now. No command was sent, and no automation was put into its waiting period.
en.test_run_skipped: Why the others would not run
en.title: SYLTRA Console
en.unauthorized_detail: Your session is not valid. Reload with a valid token to continue.
en.users_readonly_detail: Only the property owner can invite people or take access away.
en.users_readonly_title: You can see who has access, but not change it
